result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice without penalty, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and Licensor has no convenience-termination right during the Initial Period or any extension. It otherwise leaves the existing term and breach-termination provisions intact. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” creates a partial-termination right not required by the playbook and may affect package economics, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Drafting is otherwise clear and professional.
